# `morphir tool update`

- **Usage:** `morphir tool update [FLAGS] <NAME>`

Install a replacement local developer package

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Name of the tool to update

## Flags
- **`-v --version <VERSION>`** — Exact semantic version recorded for the replacement package
- **`--source <SOURCE>`** — Replacement local unsigned package
- **`--channel <CHANNEL>`** — Acquisition channel; local sources require developer
